name: Per-GPU host-to-GPU bandwidth (nvbandwidth)
description: Average physical PCIe slot ingest speed (GB/s) per single GPU utilizing CE (Copy Engine).

environment_fields.gpu_count: Number of GPUs seen by nvbandwidth.
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.p2p_supported: Whether peer-to-peer (device-to-device) GPU transfers were supported.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
